_meta.note: Launch-day data feed. Values are in-game readings as documented by phantombladezerodb.com (accessed Oct 30 14:00 CST).

weapons.name: Jagged Steel
weapons.notes: Boss weapon: drop from Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute. Lv1: 272 dmg / 103 bleed.

weapons.name: White Serpent & Crimson Viper

stats.effect: Alternating combo ends by throwing the shorter blade; marks extend Guard Broken

weapons.notes: Highest documented damage so far (Lv21). Lv1: 312 dmg / 164 Guard Break.

weapons.name: Seamless Death

stats.effect: Thrown twin rings, melee + ranged; Phantom Step perk replaces dodge with warp

weapons.notes: Lv9→10 upgrade: 12 Twinned Metal, 4 Solvent, 5,850 Remnant Dust (578→610 dmg).

weapons.name: Armybreaker
weapons.source: official footage, ~ value off blurred frame (phantombladezerodb.com)

stats.effect: High shield-breaking power on a broad-bladed polearm

weapons.notes: ≈740 read off a blurred Lv16 frame.

weapons.name: Outlaw's Warblade
weapons.source: official footage, ~ value off blurred frame (phantombladezerodb.com)

stats.effect: Blood-drinking: standard combo hits drain life and heal you

weapons.name: The Fanatic's Broken Blade

stats.effect: Drunken style: ranged attacks while Tipsy/Drunk, Drink restores Sha-Chi

weapons.notes: A.k.a. the Drunken Sword. Perks: Bottomless Drink (Lv5), Boundless Thirst (Lv10).

weapons.name: Sanguine
weapons.source: official footage, ~ value off blurred frame (phantombladezerodb.com)

stats.effect: Soul's own blade: sword-shaped, cleaver-heavy; Power Surge 'Sweeping Blade'

weapons.name: Sanguine Twin

stats.effect: Short twin swords, unmatched speed — 'strike like rain'

weapons.notes: Lv1: 223 dmg / 117 Guard Break. Made by the smith Forge.

stats.effect: Long two-handed blade; Power Surge 'Longblade Chain Slash' (unblockable, 1 Sha-Chi)

weapons.name: Scarlet Wraithblade

stats.effect: Red Spider Lilies explode for damage + Sha-Chi depletion

weapons.notes: Boss weapon: Hua, Deadly Betrothed. Lv1: 240/117.

weapons.name: Tianxuan Bronze Sword

stats.effect: High Shield-Breaking power; perk 'Natural Order' cuts Sha-Chi cost of blocking

weapons.notes: Starter-grade guard sword; Lv1 readings only.

weapons.name: Juggernaut

stats.effect: Parries store charges; at full charge the blade turns red and △ unleashes a sweeping cleave

weapons.notes: Rated hardest-hitting weapon available in the demo. Numeric stats pending in-game verification.

weapons.name: Soft Snake Sword

stats.effect: Whip-sword: timed fend-off crushes attacker's Sha-Chi; blade barrier cuts thread attacks

weapons.notes: Called the hardest weapon to master in the demo. Numeric stats pending in-game verification.

weapons.name: Baishan Stormswords
weapons.notes: Dropped by Yubi (Mandate Encampment, one of the Four Great Puppets); also reward of the tale Secrets of the Baishan Sect (pick up before the Bai Chilian fight).

weapons.name: Fiend Saws
weapons.notes: Dropped by Iron Fiend and the Jade Dancer in Village of Lu — hidden third phase of the fight.

weapons.name: Wild Oriole Sword
weapons.notes: Dropped in-game (see source for exact location).

weapons.name: Wooden Sanguine
weapons.notes: Carried from the start of the prologue; first main weapon slot when the Present Day chapter opens.
